text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You did just what you said you would! 
That's one win down!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best next time too~! I'll be 
there to watch!"

"The venue buzzes over the smooth start. 
However, the person in question..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Teio Sho in June, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
2000m... The distance is getting a bit 
longer, so let's start planning our 
strategy right away!

A brilliant 1st-place victory to mark the 
beginning. However, Smart Falcon showed no 
signs of getting carried away.

She might be calmly looking ahead, 
patiently watching for her next chance at 
victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Come on, let's head back to 
the academy~!
